correctness.rationale: For unnormalized arclength on S^1 and radial-angular mixed L^q_rad L^2_ang, reconstructed I_k(q)=integral_0^infty |J_k(r)|^q r dr. Landau for k>=3 and a rigorous J2 Bernstein degree-20 certificate on r<=4 plus Nicholson tail imply sup |J_k|<1/2 for all k>=2. The sixth moments satisfy I_k(6)<2(7/10)^6+4/(pi^3 sqrt3)<1/3 and hence I_k(q)<(64/3)2^-q for real q>=6. Taylor minorant and concavity imply J1>9/16 on [8/5,21/10], thus I1(q)>(37/40)(9/16)^q. Exact rational (37/40)(9/8)^27>64/3 closes strict ordering for every REAL q>=27. Xu spectral modal stability theorem gives Gamma_2,q=4pi^2(I0^(2/q)-I1^(2/q)), as claimed, with equality classes inherited from that theorem. Independent exact-fractions check reproduced all 21 Bernstein coefficients including min=61/43605 at index11, sixth ceiling, Taylor lower bound and q27 strict inequality. External analytic Landau/Nicholson/Xu hypotheses have to apply with the stated normalizations; the finite arithmetic certificate alone does not prove them.
